parameters.query:
-- Idempotent intake: a new submission is stored with all its items in one statement,
-- a repeated submission_id stores nothing and returns the original RFQ.
WITH input AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb AS doc
),
inserted AS (
    INSERT INTO rfqs (
        rfq_id,
        submission_id,
        status,
        received_at,
        customer_name,
        customer_email,
        subject,
        requested_delivery_date,
        source_type,
        source_reference
    )
    SELECT
        doc ->> 'rfq_id',
        doc ->> 'submission_id',
        doc ->> 'status',
        (doc ->> 'received_at')::timestamptz,
        doc -> 'customer' ->> 'name',
        doc -> 'customer' ->> 'email',
        doc ->> 'subject',
        (doc ->> 'requested_delivery_date')::date,
        doc -> 'source' ->> 'type',
        doc -> 'source' ->> 'reference'
    FROM input
    ON CONFLICT (submission_id) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING rfq_id, submission_id, status
),
inserted_items AS (
    INSERT INTO rfq_items (
        rfq_id,
        line_number,
        raw_description,
        part_number,
        quantity,
        unit
    )
    SELECT
        ins.rfq_id,
        item.line_number,
        item.raw_description,
        item.part_number,
        item.quantity,
        item.unit
    FROM inserted ins
    CROSS JOIN input i
    CROSS JOIN jsonb_to_recordset(i.doc -> 'items') AS item (
        line_number integer,
        raw_description text,
        part_number text,
        quantity numeric,
        unit text
    )
    RETURNING line_number
)
SELECT
    rfq_id,
    submission_id,
    status,
    TRUE AS is_new,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inserted_items) AS item_count
FROM inserted

UNION ALL

SELECT
    r.rfq_id,
    r.submission_id,
    r.status,
    FALSE AS is_new,
    NULL AS item_count
FROM rfqs r
WHERE r.submission_id = (SELECT doc ->> 'submission_id' FROM input)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted);

-- Claim the RFQ for processing, atomically, so it is never processed twice in parallel:
--   RECEIVED                          first run after intake, or a retry released by recovery
--   REVIEW_REQUIRED, no OPEN tasks    resume after human review (from the MATCHING checkpoint)
-- The claim is a lease: P2 - RFQ Recovery retries it when processing does not finish in time.
UPDATE rfqs r
SET
    status = 'PROCESSING',
    processing_attempts = r.processing_attempts + 1,
    processing_started_at = NOW(),
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE r.rfq_id = $1::jsonb ->> 'rfq_id'
  AND (
      r.status = 'RECEIVED'
      OR (
          r.status = 'REVIEW_REQUIRED'
          AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM review_tasks t
              WHERE t.rfq_id = r.rfq_id
                AND t.status = 'OPEN'
          )
      )
  )
RETURNING
    r.rfq_id,
    r.status,
    r.processing_attempts;

SELECT
    i.rfq_id,
    i.line_number,
    i.raw_description,
    i.part_number,
    normalize_part_number(i.part_number) AS normalized_part_number,
    i.quantity,
    i.unit,
    COALESCE(o.unavailable, FALSE) AS override_unavailable,
    o.sku AS override_sku,
    COALESCE(manual.candidates, '[]'::jsonb) AS manual_candidates,
    COALESCE(exact.candidates, '[]'::jsonb) AS exact_candidates,
    COALESCE(normalized.candidates, '[]'::jsonb) AS normalized_candidates
FROM rfq_items i
LEFT JOIN rfq_line_overrides o
    ON o.rfq_id = i.rfq_id
    AND o.line_number = i.line_number
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
            'sku', p.sku,
            'manufacturer', p.manufacturer,
            'part_number', p.part_number,
            'description', p.description,
            'unit', p.unit
        )
    ) AS candidates
    FROM catalogue_products p
    WHERE p.sku = o.sku
      AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'
) manual ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
            'sku', p.sku,
            'manufacturer', p.manufacturer,
            'part_number', p.part_number,
            'description', p.description,
            'unit', p.unit
        )
        ORDER BY p.sku
    ) AS candidates
    FROM catalogue_products p
    WHERE p.part_number = i.part_number
      AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'
) exact ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
            'sku', p.sku,
            'manufacturer', p.manufacturer,
            'part_number', p.part_number,
            'description', p.description,
            'unit', p.unit
        )
        ORDER BY p.sku
    ) AS candidates
    FROM catalogue_products p
    WHERE p.normalized_part_number = normalize_part_number(i.part_number)
      AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'
) normalized ON TRUE
WHERE i.rfq_id = $1::text
ORDER BY i.line_number;

-- One row per RFQ line with the effective price. $2 = { customer, lines: [{ line_number, sku,
-- erp_status, erp_unit_price, erp_currency }] } (customer from Recognise Customer, ERP result validated).
-- Priority: ERP live price (erp_status OK) > customer price > base price minus the customer's
-- discount > base price (a price entered in review is applied later, in Apply Pricing Rules).
WITH input AS (
    SELECT $2::jsonb AS doc
),
best AS (
    SELECT
        doc #>> '{customer,customer_code}' AS customer_code,
        (doc #>> '{customer,discount_percent}')::numeric AS discount_percent,
        doc #>> '{customer,customer_match}' AS customer_match
    FROM input
)
SELECT
    i.line_number,
    i.quantity,
    i.unit AS requested_unit,
    m.sku,
    b.customer_code,
    b.customer_match,
    CASE WHEN f.erp_live THEN m.erp_currency ELSE COALESCE(cp.currency, pr.currency) END AS currency,
    f.unit_price,
    CASE WHEN f.erp_live OR cp.unit_price IS NOT NULL THEN p.unit ELSE pr.unit END AS price_unit,
    COALESCE(pr.min_quantity, 1) AS min_quantity,
    CASE
        WHEN f.erp_live THEN 'erp_live'
        WHEN cp.unit_price IS NOT NULL THEN 'customer_price'
        WHEN pr.unit_price IS NOT NULL AND b.discount_percent > 0 THEN 'customer_discount'
        ELSE pr.source
    END AS pricing_source,
    CASE WHEN NOT f.erp_live AND (cp.unit_price IS NOT NULL OR b.discount_percent > 0) THEN pr.unit_price END AS list_unit_price,
    CASE WHEN NOT f.erp_live AND cp.unit_price IS NULL AND pr.unit_price IS NOT NULL AND b.discount_percent > 0
         THEN b.discount_percent END AS discount_percent,
    CASE WHEN f.erp_live THEN e.unit_price END AS synced_unit_price,
    m.erp_status AS erp_price_status,
    ROUND(i.quantity * f.unit_price, 2) AS line_total,
    o.unit_price AS override_unit_price,
    ROUND(i.quantity * o.unit_price, 2) AS override_line_total,
    COALESCE(o.accept_below_moq, FALSE) AS accept_below_moq
FROM rfq_items i
CROSS JOIN best b
LEFT JOIN jsonb_to_recordset((SELECT doc -> 'lines' FROM input))
    AS m (line_number integer, sku text, erp_status text, erp_unit_price numeric, erp_currency text)
    ON m.line_number = i.line_number
LEFT JOIN catalogue_products p
    ON p.sku = m.sku
LEFT JOIN prices pr
    ON pr.product_id = p.id
    AND pr.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN customer_prices cp
    ON cp.customer_code = b.customer_code
    AND cp.product_id = p.id
    AND cp.status = 'ACTIVE'
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    -- synced price: customer price > base minus discount > base
    SELECT COALESCE(
        cp.unit_price,
        CASE WHEN b.discount_percent > 0 THEN ROUND(pr.unit_price * (100 - b.discount_percent) / 100, 2) END,
        pr.unit_price
    ) AS unit_price
) e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(m.erp_status = 'OK', FALSE) AS erp_live,
        CASE WHEN m.erp_status = 'OK' THEN ROUND(m.erp_unit_price, 2) ELSE e.unit_price END AS unit_price
) f
LEFT JOIN rfq_line_overrides o
    ON o.rfq_id = i.rfq_id
    AND o.line_number = i.line_number
WHERE i.rfq_id = $1::text
ORDER BY i.line_number;

-- Atomic write of one processing run: line results, new exceptions, their review tasks
-- and the RFQ status.
WITH input AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb AS doc
),
input_exceptions AS (
    SELECT e.*
    FROM input i
    CROSS JOIN jsonb_to_recordset(i.doc -> 'exceptions') AS e (
        line_number integer,
        type text,
        severity text,
        message text,
        review_payload jsonb
    )
),
saved_lines AS (
    INSERT INTO rfq_line_results (
        rfq_id,
        line_number,
        match_status,
        match_method,
        sku,
        match_candidates,
        pricing_status,
        unit_price,
        currency,
        line_total,
        pricing_source,
        list_unit_price,
        discount_percent,
        erp_price_status,
        synced_unit_price
    )
    SELECT
        i.doc ->> 'rfq_id',
        l.line_number,
        l.matching ->> 'status',
        l.matching ->> 'method',
        l.sku,
        COALESCE(l.matching -> 'candidates', '[]'::jsonb),
        l.pricing ->> 'status',
        (l.pricing ->> 'unit_price')::numeric,
        l.pricing ->> 'currency',
        (l.pricing ->> 'total')::numeric,
        l.pricing ->> 'pricing_source',
        (l.pricing ->> 'list_unit_price')::numeric,
        (l.pricing ->> 'discount_percent')::numeric,
        l.pricing ->> 'erp_price_status',
        (l.pricing ->> 'synced_unit_price')::numeric
    FROM input i
    CROSS JOIN jsonb_to_recordset(i.doc -> 'lines') AS l (
        line_number integer,
        sku text,
        matching jsonb,
        pricing jsonb
    )
    ON CONFLICT (rfq_id, line_number)
    DO UPDATE SET
        match_status = EXCLUDED.match_status,
        match_method = EXCLUDED.match_method,
        sku = EXCLUDED.sku,
        match_candidates = EXCLUDED.match_candidates,
        pricing_status = EXCLUDED.pricing_status,
        unit_price = EXCLUDED.unit_price,
        currency = EXCLUDED.currency,
        line_total = EXCLUDED.line_total,
        pricing_source = EXCLUDED.pricing_source,
        list_unit_price = EXCLUDED.list_unit_price,
        discount_percent = EXCLUDED.discount_percent,
        erp_price_status = EXCLUDED.erp_price_status,
        synced_unit_price = EXCLUDED.synced_unit_price,
        updated_at = NOW()
    RETURNING line_number
),
created_exceptions AS (
    INSERT INTO exceptions (
        rfq_id,
        line_number,
        type,
        severity,
        message
    )
    SELECT
        (SELECT doc ->> 'rfq_id' FROM input),
        e.line_number,
        e.type,
        e.severity,
        e.message
    FROM input_exceptions e
    ON CONFLICT (rfq_id, line_number, type) WHERE status = 'OPEN' DO NOTHING
    RETURNING id, rfq_id, line_number, type
),
created_review_tasks AS (
    INSERT INTO review_tasks (
        rfq_id,
        exception_id,
        line_number,
        review_type,
        payload
    )
    SELECT
        ce.rfq_id,
        ce.id,
        ce.line_number,
        ce.type,
        e.review_payload
    FROM created_exceptions ce
    JOIN input_exceptions e
        ON e.line_number IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ce.line_number
        AND e.type = ce.type
    RETURNING id
),
updated_rfq AS (
    UPDATE rfqs
    SET
        status = (SELECT doc ->> 'status' FROM input),
        customer_code = (SELECT doc #>> '{customer,customer_code}' FROM input),
        customer_match = (SELECT doc #>> '{customer,customer_match}' FROM input),
        -- A finished run ends the lease and resets the consecutive failure counter.
        processing_attempts = 0,
        processing_started_at = NULL,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE rfq_id = (SELECT doc ->> 'rfq_id' FROM input)
    RETURNING rfq_id, status
)
SELECT
    u.rfq_id,
    u.status,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM saved_lines) AS saved_line_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM created_exceptions) AS created_exception_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM created_review_tasks) AS created_review_task_count
FROM updated_rfq u;

-- The review channel is configuration: core only knows "notify reviewers about new tasks".
SELECT
    $1::jsonb ->> 'rfq_id' AS rfq_id,
    (
        SELECT NULLIF(value #>> '{}', '')
        FROM app_settings
        WHERE key = 'review_notification_workflow_id'
    ) AS notification_workflow_id;

WITH input AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb AS doc
)
SELECT
    t.id AS review_task_id,
    t.rfq_id,
    t.line_number,
    t.review_type,
    t.status,
    t.payload -> 'allowed_actions' AS allowed_actions,
    t.access_token = (SELECT doc ->> 'token' FROM input) AS token_valid,
    (
        SELECT p.sku
        FROM catalogue_products p
        WHERE p.sku = (SELECT doc ->> 'selected_sku' FROM input)
          AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'
    ) AS active_selected_sku
FROM review_tasks t
WHERE t.id = (SELECT (doc ->> 'review_task_id')::bigint FROM input);

-- Atomic resolution: close the task and its exception, store the decision as a line override.
-- The task is resolved only if it is still OPEN, so two concurrent decisions cannot both win.
WITH input AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb AS doc
),
resolved_task AS (
    UPDATE review_tasks t
    SET
        status = 'RESOLVED',
        resolution = jsonb_build_object(
            'action', i.doc ->> 'action',
            'selected_sku', i.doc -> 'selected_sku',
            'unit_price', i.doc -> 'unit_price',
            'note', i.doc -> 'note'
        ),
        resolved_by = i.doc ->> 'resolved_by',
        resolved_at = NOW()
    FROM input i
    WHERE t.id = (i.doc ->> 'review_task_id')::bigint
      AND t.status = 'OPEN'
    RETURNING t.id, t.rfq_id, t.line_number, t.exception_id
),
resolved_exception AS (
    UPDATE exceptions e
    SET status = 'RESOLVED'
    FROM resolved_task rt
    WHERE e.id = rt.exception_id
    RETURNING e.id
),
saved_override AS (
    INSERT INTO rfq_line_overrides (
        rfq_id,
        line_number,
        sku,
        unit_price,
        accept_below_moq,
        unavailable,
        last_action,
        updated_by
    )
    SELECT
        rt.rfq_id,
        rt.line_number,
        CASE WHEN i.doc ->> 'action' = 'SELECT_PRODUCT' THEN i.doc ->> 'selected_sku' END,
        CASE WHEN i.doc ->> 'action' = 'ENTER_PRICE' THEN (i.doc ->> 'unit_price')::numeric END,
        i.doc ->> 'action' = 'ACCEPT_BELOW_MOQ',
        i.doc ->> 'action' = 'MARK_UNAVAILABLE',
        i.doc ->> 'action',
        i.doc ->> 'resolved_by'
    FROM resolved_task rt
    CROSS JOIN input i
    ON CONFLICT (rfq_id, line_number)
    DO UPDATE SET
        -- Selecting another product invalidates a manual price and MOQ acceptance for the old one.
        sku = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.last_action = 'SELECT_PRODUCT'
                   THEN EXCLUDED.sku ELSE rfq_line_overrides.sku END,
        unit_price = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.last_action = 'SELECT_PRODUCT' THEN NULL
                          WHEN EXCLUDED.last_action = 'ENTER_PRICE' THEN EXCLUDED.unit_price
                          ELSE rfq_line_overrides.unit_price END,
        accept_below_moq = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.last_action = 'SELECT_PRODUCT' THEN FALSE
                                WHEN EXCLUDED.last_action = 'ACCEPT_BELOW_MOQ' THEN TRUE
                                ELSE rfq_line_overrides.accept_below_moq END,
        unavailable = rfq_line_overrides.unavailable OR EXCLUDED.unavailable,
        last_action = EXCLUDED.last_action,
        updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by,
        updated_at = NOW()
    RETURNING rfq_id
)
SELECT
    rt.id AS review_task_id,
    rt.rfq_id,
    rt.line_number,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resolved_exception) AS resolved_exception_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM saved_override) AS saved_override_count
FROM resolved_task rt;

-- Separate statement after the resolution is committed, so it sees decisions committed
-- concurrently: the last committed decision always observes zero open tasks.
SELECT
    $1::jsonb ->> 'rfq_id' AS rfq_id,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM review_tasks t
        WHERE t.rfq_id = $1::jsonb ->> 'rfq_id'
          AND t.status = 'OPEN'
    ) AS open_task_count;

parameters.query:
-- Recovery: find stuck work, mark it atomically (overlapping runs never act twice) and return one
-- command per row: { operation, payload } for the workflow in workflow_id (NULL = this core).
--   process                 RFQ never processed, expired PROCESSING lease, lost resume after review
--   notify_reviewers        OPEN review tasks without a sent notification
--   create_quote            PRICED RFQ without a quote
--   request_quote_approval  quote waiting for a person whose notification was not sent
--   send_quote              APPROVED quote whose delivery was never started
--   ops_event               RFQ that exhausted its attempts (FAILED) → administrator alert
-- Reported only (operation NULL): quote whose delivery lease expired (SEND_UNCERTAIN: a person
-- decides; the system never re-sends to a customer).
WITH cfg AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE((SELECT (value #>> '{}')::int FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'processing_lease_minutes'), 10) AS lease_minutes,
        COALESCE((SELECT (value #>> '{}')::int FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'max_processing_attempts'), 3) AS max_attempts,
        COALESCE((SELECT (value #>> '{}')::int FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'recovery_grace_minutes'), 2) AS grace_minutes,
        (SELECT NULLIF(value #>> '{}', '') FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'review_notification_workflow_id') AS review_workflow_id,
        (SELECT NULLIF(value #>> '{}', '') FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'quote_delivery_workflow_id') AS delivery_workflow_id,
        (SELECT NULLIF(value #>> '{}', '') FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'ops_workflow_id') AS ops_workflow_id
),
-- Every run records it is alive; GET /webhook/health reports a stale heartbeat.
heartbeat AS (
    INSERT INTO system_heartbeats (name, last_seen_at)
    VALUES ('core_recovery', NOW())
    ON CONFLICT (name) DO UPDATE SET last_seen_at = EXCLUDED.last_seen_at
    RETURNING name
),
expired_leases AS (
    SELECT r.rfq_id, r.processing_attempts
    FROM rfqs r, cfg
    WHERE r.status = 'PROCESSING'
      AND r.processing_started_at < NOW() - make_interval(mins => cfg.lease_minutes)
    FOR UPDATE OF r SKIP LOCKED
),
failed AS (
    UPDATE rfqs r
    SET
        status = 'FAILED',
        last_error = format(
            'Processing did not finish within %s minutes (attempt %s of %s). Retries exhausted.',
            cfg.lease_minutes, e.processing_attempts, cfg.max_attempts),
        processing_started_at = NULL,
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM expired_leases e, cfg
    WHERE r.rfq_id = e.rfq_id
      AND e.processing_attempts >= cfg.max_attempts
    RETURNING r.rfq_id, r.last_error
),
released AS (
    UPDATE rfqs r
    SET
        status = 'RECEIVED',
        last_error = format(
            'Processing did not finish within %s minutes (attempt %s of %s). Retrying.',
            cfg.lease_minutes, e.processing_attempts, cfg.max_attempts),
        processing_started_at = NULL,
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM expired_leases e, cfg
    WHERE r.rfq_id = e.rfq_id
      AND e.processing_attempts < cfg.max_attempts
    RETURNING r.rfq_id, r.last_error
),
-- Touching updated_at throttles repeated dispatch of the same work to once per grace period.
waiting AS (
    UPDATE rfqs r
    SET updated_at = NOW()
    FROM cfg
    WHERE r.updated_at < NOW() - make_interval(mins => cfg.grace_minutes)
      AND (
          r.status = 'RECEIVED'
          OR (
              r.status = 'REVIEW_REQUIRED'
              AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review_tasks t WHERE t.rfq_id = r.rfq_id AND t.status = 'OPEN')
              AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exceptions x WHERE x.rfq_id = r.rfq_id AND x.status = 'OPEN')
          )
      )
    RETURNING r.rfq_id, r.status
),
unnotified AS (
    UPDATE review_tasks t
    SET notify_attempted_at = NOW()
    FROM cfg
    WHERE t.status = 'OPEN'
      AND t.notified_at IS NULL
      AND cfg.review_workflow_id IS NOT NULL
      AND COALESCE(t.notify_attempted_at, t.created_at) < NOW() - make_interval(mins => cfg.grace_minutes)
    RETURNING t.rfq_id
),
unquoted AS (
    UPDATE rfqs r
    SET updated_at = NOW()
    FROM cfg
    WHERE r.status = 'PRICED'
      AND r.updated_at < NOW() - make_interval(mins => cfg.grace_minutes)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM quotes q WHERE q.rfq_id = r.rfq_id)
    RETURNING r.rfq_id
),
unnotified_quotes AS (
    UPDATE quotes q
    SET notify_attempted_at = NOW()
    FROM cfg
    WHERE q.status IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL', 'SEND_UNCERTAIN')
      AND q.notified_at IS NULL
      AND cfg.review_workflow_id IS NOT NULL
      AND COALESCE(q.notify_attempted_at, q.updated_at) < NOW() - make_interval(mins => cfg.grace_minutes)
    RETURNING q.quote_id
),
undelivered AS (
    UPDATE quotes q
    SET updated_at = NOW()
    FROM cfg
    WHERE q.status = 'APPROVED'
      AND cfg.delivery_workflow_id IS NOT NULL
      AND q.updated_at < NOW() - make_interval(mins => cfg.grace_minutes)
    RETURNING q.quote_id
),
uncertain AS (
    UPDATE quotes q
    SET
        status = 'SEND_UNCERTAIN',
        notified_at = NULL,
        last_error = format('Delivery did not confirm within %s minutes; the email may or may not have been sent.', cfg.lease_minutes),
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM cfg
    WHERE q.status = 'SENDING'
      AND q.send_attempted_at < NOW() - make_interval(mins => cfg.lease_minutes)
    RETURNING q.quote_id, q.last_error
)
SELECT 'process'::text AS operation, jsonb_build_object('rfq_id', rfq_id) AS payload, NULL::text AS workflow_id, last_error AS reason
FROM released
UNION ALL
SELECT 'process', jsonb_build_object('rfq_id', rfq_id), NULL::text, 'Stuck in ' || status || '.' FROM waiting
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT 'notify_reviewers', jsonb_build_object('rfq_id', u.rfq_id), cfg.review_workflow_id, 'Review notification was not sent.'
FROM unnotified u, cfg
UNION ALL
SELECT 'create_quote', jsonb_build_object('rfq_id', rfq_id), NULL::text, 'PRICED without a quote.' FROM unquoted
UNION ALL
SELECT 'request_quote_approval', jsonb_build_object('quote_id', quote_id), cfg.review_workflow_id, 'Approval notification was not sent.'
FROM unnotified_quotes, cfg
UNION ALL
SELECT 'send_quote', jsonb_build_object('quote_id', quote_id), cfg.delivery_workflow_id, 'Approved quote was not delivered.'
FROM undelivered, cfg
UNION ALL
-- An RFQ that exhausted its attempts is reported to the administrator (ops_event).
SELECT 'ops_event', jsonb_build_object('event_type', 'rfq_failed', 'reference', rfq_id, 'message', last_error, 'workflow_name', 'P2 - RFQ Core'), cfg.ops_workflow_id, last_error
FROM failed, cfg
WHERE cfg.ops_workflow_id IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL::text, jsonb_build_object('quote_id', quote_id), NULL::text, last_error FROM uncertain;

parameters.content:
## RFQ Core
Command API: `{ operation, payload }` from channel workflows.
- `intake` — canonical RFQ → validation → idempotent insert → async `process`
- `process` — `{ rfq_id }` → matching → pricing → policy → review tasks / `create_quote`
- `review_decision` — review decision → overrides → async `process` when no open tasks
- `create_quote` — `{ rfq_id }` → quote draft (frozen prices, VAT, threshold) → approval request
- `quote_decision` — approve / reject / mark sent / resend → delivery channel
- `import_data` — `{ kind, rows, source?, filename? }` → validated snapshot of catalogue / customers / customer prices
Self-calls use `$workflow.id`; channel ids come from `app_settings`.
### Recovery — every minute: stuck RFQs, expired leases, lost resumes, unsent review notifications

-- Create the quote draft of a PRICED RFQ in one atomic statement: quote, frozen lines, RFQ status.
-- Deterministic: totals are numeric arithmetic in the database, never done by the LLM or in floats.
-- Idempotent: one quote per RFQ (UNIQUE rfq_id), and only a PRICED RFQ can get one.
WITH input AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb ->> 'rfq_id' AS rfq_id
),
cfg AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE((SELECT (value #>> '{}')::numeric FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'vat_rate'), 23) AS vat_rate,
        COALESCE((SELECT (value #>> '{}')::int FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'quote_validity_days'), 14) AS validity_days,
        (SELECT (value #>> '{}')::numeric FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'approval_threshold_net') AS threshold
),
rfq AS (
    SELECT r.*
    FROM rfqs r
    WHERE r.rfq_id = (SELECT rfq_id FROM input)
      AND r.status = 'PRICED'
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM quotes q WHERE q.rfq_id = r.rfq_id)
    FOR UPDATE
),
lines AS (
    SELECT
        l.line_number,
        l.pricing_status,
        l.sku,
        l.unit_price,
        l.line_total,
        l.currency,
        l.pricing_source,
        l.list_unit_price,
        l.discount_percent,
        l.erp_price_status,
        l.synced_unit_price,
        i.raw_description,
        i.quantity,
        i.unit,
        p.description AS product_description,
        p.part_number
    FROM rfq_line_results l
    JOIN rfq_items i USING (rfq_id, line_number)
    LEFT JOIN catalogue_products p ON p.sku = l.sku
    WHERE l.rfq_id = (SELECT rfq_id FROM rfq)
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(line_total) FILTER (WHERE pricing_status = 'VALID'), 0) AS subtotal_net,
        MAX(currency) AS currency
    FROM lines
),
new_quote AS (
    INSERT INTO quotes (
        quote_id,
        rfq_id,
        status,
        currency,
        subtotal_net,
        vat_rate,
        vat_amount,
        total_gross,
        valid_until,
        approval_level,
        customer_name,
        customer_email,
        customer_code,
        customer_match
    )
    SELECT
        'QUO-' || to_char(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || upper(substr(md5(random()::text), 1, 6)),
        rfq.rfq_id,
        'PENDING_APPROVAL',
        COALESCE(t.currency, 'PLN'),
        t.subtotal_net,
        cfg.vat_rate,
        ROUND(t.subtotal_net * cfg.vat_rate / 100, 2),
        t.subtotal_net + ROUND(t.subtotal_net * cfg.vat_rate / 100, 2),
        CURRENT_DATE + cfg.validity_days,
        CASE WHEN cfg.threshold IS NOT NULL AND t.subtotal_net > cfg.threshold THEN 'ELEVATED' ELSE 'STANDARD' END,
        rfq.customer_name,
        rfq.customer_email,
        rfq.customer_code,
        rfq.customer_match
    FROM rfq, totals t, cfg
    RETURNING quote_id, rfq_id
),
new_items AS (
    INSERT INTO quote_items (
        quote_id,
        line_number,
        raw_description,
        sku,
        description,
        part_number,
        quantity,
        unit,
        unit_price,
        line_total,
        status,
        pricing_source,
        list_unit_price,
        discount_percent,
        erp_price_status,
        synced_unit_price
    )
    SELECT
        q.quote_id,
        l.line_number,
        l.raw_description,
        l.sku,
        l.product_description,
        l.part_number,
        l.quantity,
        l.unit,
        CASE WHEN l.pricing_status = 'VALID' THEN l.unit_price END,
        CASE WHEN l.pricing_status = 'VALID' THEN l.line_total END,
        CASE WHEN l.pricing_status = 'VALID' THEN 'QUOTED' ELSE 'UNAVAILABLE' END,
        CASE WHEN l.pricing_status = 'VALID' THEN l.pricing_source END,
        CASE WHEN l.pricing_status = 'VALID' THEN l.list_unit_price END,
        CASE WHEN l.pricing_status = 'VALID' THEN l.discount_percent END,
        CASE WHEN l.pricing_status = 'VALID' THEN l.erp_price_status END,
        CASE WHEN l.pricing_status = 'VALID' THEN l.synced_unit_price END
    FROM new_quote q, lines l
    RETURNING line_number
),
drafted AS (
    UPDATE rfqs r
    SET status = 'QUOTE_DRAFTED', updated_at = NOW()
    FROM new_quote q
    WHERE r.rfq_id = q.rfq_id
    RETURNING r.rfq_id
)
SELECT
    q.quote_id,
    q.rfq_id,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM new_items) AS item_count,
    (SELECT NULLIF(value #>> '{}', '') FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'review_notification_workflow_id') AS approval_workflow_id
FROM new_quote q;

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { operation: "request_quote_approval", payload: { quote_id: $input.first().json.quote_id }, workflow_id: $input.first().json.approval_workflow_id } }];
return [{ json: { operation: "create_quote", payload: { rfq_id: $input.first().json.rfq_id } } }];

// operation: quote_decision — payload { quote_id, action, decided_by, reason? } from an approval channel.
return [{ json: $input.first().json.payload ?? {} }];

return [{ json: { http_status: 422, body: { status: "REJECTED", reason: "INVALID_QUOTE_DECISION", errors } } }];

-- Apply a quote decision atomically, only if the quote is still in the status the decision was
-- validated against (two concurrent decisions cannot both win).
WITH input AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb AS doc
),
decided AS (
    UPDATE quotes q
    SET
        status = CASE i.doc ->> 'action'
                     WHEN 'APPROVE' THEN 'APPROVED'
                     WHEN 'REJECT' THEN 'REJECTED'
                     WHEN 'MARK_SENT' THEN 'SENT'
                     WHEN 'RESEND' THEN 'APPROVED'
                 END,
        decided_by = CASE WHEN i.doc ->> 'action' IN ('APPROVE', 'REJECT') THEN i.doc ->> 'decided_by' ELSE q.decided_by END,
        decided_at = CASE WHEN i.doc ->> 'action' IN ('APPROVE', 'REJECT') THEN NOW() ELSE q.decided_at END,
        rejection_reason = CASE WHEN i.doc ->> 'action' = 'REJECT' THEN i.doc ->> 'reason' ELSE q.rejection_reason END,
        sent_at = CASE WHEN i.doc ->> 'action' = 'MARK_SENT' THEN NOW() ELSE q.sent_at END,
        last_error = CASE WHEN i.doc ->> 'action' = 'MARK_SENT'
                          THEN 'Marked as sent by ' || (i.doc ->> 'decided_by') || ' after an uncertain delivery.'
                          ELSE q.last_error END,
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM input i
    WHERE q.quote_id = i.doc ->> 'quote_id'
      AND q.status = i.doc ->> 'expected_status'
    RETURNING q.quote_id, q.rfq_id, q.status
),
rfq_status AS (
    UPDATE rfqs r
    SET
        status = CASE d.status WHEN 'SENT' THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN 'QUOTE_REJECTED' ELSE r.status END,
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM decided d
    WHERE r.rfq_id = d.rfq_id
      AND d.status IN ('SENT', 'REJECTED')
    RETURNING r.rfq_id
)
SELECT
    d.quote_id,
    d.rfq_id,
    d.status,
    (SELECT NULLIF(value #>> '{}', '') FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'quote_delivery_workflow_id') AS delivery_workflow_id
FROM decided d;

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { operation: "send_quote", payload: { quote_id: $input.first().json.body.quote_id }, workflow_id: $input.first().json.delivery_workflow_id } }];

const { http_status: httpStatus, body } = $('Check Quote Decision Applied').first().json;
return [{ json: { http_status: httpStatus, body } }];

const { operation, payload, workflow_id: workflowId } = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { operation, payload, workflow_id: workflowId } }];

parameters.query:
-- Matching level 3, step 1 (deterministic): preselect catalogue candidates for lines without a
-- match by shared words (manufacturer, description, part number). Only these candidates are ever
-- offered to the LLM. Stored results are returned so the LLM is never asked twice for a line.
WITH input AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb AS doc
),
cfg AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE((SELECT (value #>> '{}')::boolean FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'semantic_matching_enabled'), FALSE) AS enabled,
        COALESCE((SELECT (value #>> '{}')::int FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'semantic_max_candidates'), 20) AS max_candidates,
        (SELECT value #>> '{}' FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'llm_model') AS llm_model
),
lines AS (
    SELECT l.line_number, l.raw_description, l.part_number
    FROM input i
    CROSS JOIN jsonb_to_recordset(i.doc -> 'lines') AS l (line_number integer, raw_description text, part_number text)
),
tokens AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.line_number, t.token
    FROM lines l
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL regexp_split_to_table(
        lower(l.raw_description || ' ' || COALESCE(l.part_number, '')), '[^[:alnum:]]+') AS t (token)
    WHERE length(t.token) >= 2
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        t.line_number,
        p.sku,
        p.manufacturer,
        p.part_number,
        p.description,
        p.unit,
        COUNT(*) AS score
    FROM tokens t
    JOIN catalogue_products p
        ON p.status = 'ACTIVE'
       AND position(t.token IN lower(p.manufacturer || ' ' || p.description || ' ' || p.part_number || ' ' || p.sku)) > 0
    GROUP BY t.line_number, p.sku, p.manufacturer, p.part_number, p.description, p.unit
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT s.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.line_number ORDER BY s.score DESC, s.sku) AS rank
    FROM scored s
)
SELECT
    l.line_number,
    l.raw_description,
    l.part_number,
    (SELECT enabled FROM cfg) AS enabled,
    (SELECT llm_model FROM cfg) AS llm_model,
    COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                   'sku', r.sku, 'manufacturer', r.manufacturer, 'part_number', r.part_number,
                   'description', r.description, 'unit', r.unit, 'score', r.score)
               ORDER BY r.rank)
        FROM ranked r, cfg
        WHERE r.line_number = l.line_number AND r.rank <= cfg.max_candidates
    ), '[]'::jsonb) AS candidates,
    (
        SELECT to_jsonb(s)
        FROM semantic_match_results s
        WHERE s.rfq_id = (SELECT doc ->> 'rfq_id' FROM input)
          AND s.line_number = l.line_number
    ) AS stored,
    (SELECT jsonb_agg(DISTINCT manufacturer) FROM catalogue_products WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') AS manufacturers,
    (SELECT NULLIF(value #>> '{}', '') FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'ops_workflow_id') AS ops_workflow_id
FROM lines l
ORDER BY l.line_number;

-- Store each line's result once; an existing result is never replaced, so reprocessing reuses it.
INSERT INTO semantic_match_results (
    rfq_id, line_number, status, suggested_sku, reason, candidates, validation_errors, llm_model, llm_usage
)
SELECT
    $1::jsonb ->> 'rfq_id',
    r.line_number,
    r.status,
    r.suggested_sku,
    r.reason,
    r.candidates,
    r.validation_errors,
    r.llm_model,
    r.llm_usage
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb -> 'results') AS r (
    line_number integer, status text, suggested_sku text, reason text,
    candidates jsonb, validation_errors jsonb, llm_model text, llm_usage jsonb
)
ON CONFLICT (rfq_id, line_number) DO NOTHING
RETURNING line_number, status;

-- Reference data for validating one import batch, plus the content hash (the same file is applied once).
WITH input AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb AS doc
),
hashed AS (
    SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to((doc -> 'rows')::text, 'UTF8')), 'hex') AS content_hash, doc ->> 'kind' AS kind
    FROM input
)
SELECT
    h.content_hash,
    COALESCE((
        SELECT b.content_hash = h.content_hash FROM import_batches b
        WHERE b.kind = h.kind AND b.status = 'APPLIED'
        ORDER BY b.created_at DESC, b.id DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ), FALSE) AS already_applied,  -- identical to the last applied batch of this kind
    (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(key, value) FROM app_settings
      WHERE key IN ('import_columns', 'unit_aliases', 'default_currency', 'import_max_deactivation_percent', 'ops_workflow_id')) AS settings,
    (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'sku', sku, 'manufacturer', manufacturer, 'part_number', part_number, 'active', status = 'ACTIVE')), '[]'::jsonb)
      FROM catalogue_products) AS products,
    (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('customer_code', customer_code, 'active', active)), '[]'::jsonb)
      FROM customers) AS customers,
    (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('customer_code', cp.customer_code, 'sku', p.sku)), '[]'::jsonb)
      FROM customer_prices cp JOIN catalogue_products p ON p.id = cp.product_id
      WHERE cp.status = 'ACTIVE') AS active_customer_prices
FROM hashed h;

-- Apply a validated catalogue snapshot atomically: products, base prices and the batch record.
-- Missing products and removed prices are deactivated, never deleted.
WITH input AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb AS doc
),
rows AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset((SELECT doc -> 'rows' FROM input)) AS r (
        sku text, manufacturer text, part_number text, description text, unit text,
        price numeric, currency text, min_quantity numeric)
),
upserted AS (
    INSERT INTO catalogue_products (sku, manufacturer, part_number, description, unit, status, updated_at)
    SELECT sku, manufacturer, part_number, description, unit, 'ACTIVE', NOW() FROM rows
    ON CONFLICT (sku) DO UPDATE SET
        manufacturer = EXCLUDED.manufacturer,
        part_number = EXCLUDED.part_number,
        description = EXCLUDED.description,
        unit = EXCLUDED.unit,
        status = 'ACTIVE',
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE (catalogue_products.manufacturer, catalogue_products.part_number, catalogue_products.description,
           catalogue_products.unit, catalogue_products.status)
          IS DISTINCT FROM (EXCLUDED.manufacturer, EXCLUDED.part_number, EXCLUDED.description, EXCLUDED.unit, 'ACTIVE')
    RETURNING id, sku, (xmax = 0) AS inserted
),
deactivated AS (
    UPDATE catalogue_products p
    SET status = 'INACTIVE', updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.sku NOT IN (SELECT sku FROM rows)
    RETURNING p.id
),
-- Product ids: existing products from the snapshot, new ones from this statement.
product_ids AS (
    SELECT id, sku FROM catalogue_products
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id, sku FROM upserted WHERE inserted
),
price_rows AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.sku) pi.id AS product_id, r.*
    FROM rows r JOIN product_ids pi ON pi.sku = r.sku
),
prices_updated AS (
    UPDATE prices pr
    SET unit_price = r.price, currency = r.currency, unit = r.unit, min_quantity = r.min_quantity,
        source = 'erp_import', updated_at = NOW()
    FROM price_rows r
    WHERE pr.product_id = r.product_id AND pr.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.price IS NOT NULL
      AND (pr.unit_price, pr.currency, pr.unit, pr.min_quantity) IS DISTINCT FROM (r.price, r.currency, r.unit, r.min_quantity)
    RETURNING pr.product_id
),
prices_inserted AS (
    INSERT INTO prices (product_id, currency, unit_price, unit, min_quantity, source)
    SELECT r.product_id, r.currency, r.price, r.unit, r.min_quantity, 'erp_import'
    FROM price_rows r
    WHERE r.price IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prices pr WHERE pr.product_id = r.product_id AND pr.status = 'ACTIVE')
    RETURNING product_id
),
prices_deactivated AS (
    UPDATE prices pr
    SET status = 'INACTIVE', updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE pr.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND (pr.product_id IN (SELECT id FROM deactivated)
           OR pr.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM price_rows WHERE price IS NULL))
    RETURNING pr.product_id
),
batch AS (
    INSERT INTO import_batches (kind, source, filename, content_hash, status, row_count, summary)
    SELECT 'catalogue', doc ->> 'source', doc ->> 'filename', doc ->> 'content_hash', 'APPLIED',
           jsonb_array_length(doc -> 'rows'),
           jsonb_build_object(
               'products_inserted', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM upserted WHERE inserted),
               'products_updated', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM upserted WHERE NOT inserted),
               'products_deactivated', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deactivated),
               'prices_changed', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prices_updated) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prices_inserted),
               'prices_deactivated', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prices_deactivated))
    FROM input
    RETURNING id, summary
)
SELECT id AS batch_id, summary FROM batch;

options.queryReplacement: =$1 → {{ JSON.stringify({ source: $('Import Command').first().json.source ?? 'api', filename: $('Import Command').first().json.filename ?? null, content_hash: $json.content_hash, rows: $json.rows }) }}

parameters.query:
-- Apply a validated customers snapshot atomically. Missing customers are deactivated together
-- with their individual prices.
WITH input AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb AS doc
),
rows AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset((SELECT doc -> 'rows' FROM input)) AS r (
        customer_code text, name text, tax_id text, emails jsonb, discount_percent numeric)
),
upserted AS (
    INSERT INTO customers (customer_code, name, tax_id, emails, discount_percent, active, updated_at)
    SELECT customer_code, name, tax_id, ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(emails)), discount_percent, TRUE, NOW()
    FROM rows
    ON CONFLICT (customer_code) DO UPDATE SET
        name = EXCLUDED.name,
        tax_id = EXCLUDED.tax_id,
        emails = EXCLUDED.emails,
        discount_percent = EXCLUDED.discount_percent,
        active = TRUE,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE (customers.name, customers.tax_id, customers.emails, customers.discount_percent, customers.active)
          IS DISTINCT FROM (EXCLUDED.name, EXCLUDED.tax_id, EXCLUDED.emails, EXCLUDED.discount_percent, TRUE)
    RETURNING customer_code, (xmax = 0) AS inserted
),
deactivated AS (
    UPDATE customers c
    SET active = FALSE, updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE c.active AND c.customer_code NOT IN (SELECT customer_code FROM rows)
    RETURNING c.customer_code
),
prices_deactivated AS (
    UPDATE customer_prices cp
    SET status = 'INACTIVE', updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE cp.status = 'ACTIVE' AND cp.customer_code IN (SELECT customer_code FROM deactivated)
    RETURNING 1
),
batch AS (
    INSERT INTO import_batches (kind, source, filename, content_hash, status, row_count, summary)
    SELECT 'customers', doc ->> 'source', doc ->> 'filename', doc ->> 'content_hash', 'APPLIED',
           jsonb_array_length(doc -> 'rows'),
           jsonb_build_object(
               'customers_inserted', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM upserted WHERE inserted),
               'customers_updated', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM upserted WHERE NOT inserted),
               'customers_deactivated', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deactivated),
               'customer_prices_deactivated', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prices_deactivated))
    FROM input
    RETURNING id, summary
)
SELECT id AS batch_id, summary FROM batch;

-- Apply a validated snapshot of individual customer prices atomically.
WITH input AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb AS doc
),
rows AS (
    SELECT r.*, p.id AS product_id
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset((SELECT doc -> 'rows' FROM input)) AS r (customer_code text, sku text, price numeric, currency text)
    JOIN catalogue_products p ON p.sku = r.sku
),
upserted AS (
    INSERT INTO customer_prices (customer_code, product_id, currency, unit_price, status, updated_at)
    SELECT customer_code, product_id, currency, price, 'ACTIVE', NOW() FROM rows
    ON CONFLICT (customer_code, product_id) DO UPDATE SET
        currency = EXCLUDED.currency,
        unit_price = EXCLUDED.unit_price,
        status = 'ACTIVE',
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE (customer_prices.currency, customer_prices.unit_price, customer_prices.status)
          IS DISTINCT FROM (EXCLUDED.currency, EXCLUDED.unit_price, 'ACTIVE')
    RETURNING (xmax = 0) AS inserted
),
deactivated AS (
    UPDATE customer_prices cp
    SET status = 'INACTIVE', updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE cp.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rows r WHERE r.customer_code = cp.customer_code AND r.product_id = cp.product_id)
    RETURNING 1
),
batch AS (
    INSERT INTO import_batches (kind, source, filename, content_hash, status, row_count, summary)
    SELECT 'customer_prices', doc ->> 'source', doc ->> 'filename', doc ->> 'content_hash', 'APPLIED',
           jsonb_array_length(doc -> 'rows'),
           jsonb_build_object(
               'prices_inserted', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM upserted WHERE inserted),
               'prices_updated', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM upserted WHERE NOT inserted),
               'prices_deactivated', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deactivated))
    FROM input
    RETURNING id, summary
)
SELECT id AS batch_id, summary FROM batch;

-- A rejected import is kept for the audit trail (the ERP data must be fixed and sent again).
INSERT INTO import_batches (kind, source, filename, content_hash, status, row_count, errors)
SELECT
    doc ->> 'kind',
    COALESCE(doc ->> 'source', 'api'),
    doc ->> 'filename',
    COALESCE(doc ->> 'content_hash', ''),
    'REJECTED',
    COALESCE((doc ->> 'row_count')::int, 0),
    COALESCE(doc -> 'errors', '[]'::jsonb)
FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS doc) input
RETURNING id AS batch_id;

parameters.query:
-- The customer is recognised from the RFQ sender at every run (customer data may change between
-- review rounds): an exact address beats a domain entry ('@firma.pl'); two active customers on the
-- best level = not recognised (never apply another customer's prices). Plus the pricing settings.
WITH input AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb ->> 'rfq_id' AS rfq_id
),
candidates AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_code,
        c.discount_percent,
        CASE WHEN lower(r.customer_email) = ANY (c.emails) THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS match_rank
    FROM rfqs r
    JOIN customers c
        ON c.active
        AND c.emails && ARRAY[lower(r.customer_email), '@' || split_part(lower(r.customer_email), '@', 2)]
    WHERE r.rfq_id = (SELECT rfq_id FROM input)
      AND r.customer_email LIKE '%@%'
),
best AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(customer_code) AS customer_code,
        MIN(discount_percent) AS discount_percent,
        CASE MIN(match_rank) WHEN 1 THEN 'EMAIL' ELSE 'DOMAIN' END AS customer_match
    FROM candidates
    WHERE match_rank = (SELECT MIN(match_rank) FROM candidates)
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
)
SELECT
    (SELECT to_jsonb(b) FROM best b) AS customer,
    (SELECT NULLIF(value #>> '{}', '') FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'erp_price_check_workflow_id') AS erp_workflow_id,
    (SELECT NULLIF(value #>> '{}', '') FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'ops_workflow_id') AS ops_workflow_id,
    COALESCE((SELECT value #>> '{}' FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'default_currency'), 'PLN') AS currency,
    (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('line_number', i.line_number, 'quantity', i.quantity, 'unit', i.unit)
                     ORDER BY i.line_number), '[]'::jsonb)
       FROM rfq_items i WHERE i.rfq_id = (SELECT rfq_id FROM input)) AS items;
